title: One country's attempt to block YouTube blocked it worldwide
body: In 2008 Pakistan Telecom, ordered to block YouTube domestically, announced a more specific route for YouTube's address block, and much of the Internet obligingly routed YouTube traffic to Pakistan, where it vanished. BGP trusts announcements; specificity beats legitimacy. The global outage lasted hours and remains the textbook route-hijack case study.
source_hint: Renesys / RIPE analyses of the 2008 hijack
